meeting_point: In front of Faneuil Hall at the Samuel Adams statue
location_address: Samuel Adams Statue in front of Faneuil Hall Boston, MA US 02109
accessibility: mostly flat surfaces and little to no inclines. Stroller and wheelchair accessible
description:
Travel through 300 years of history on this fun and interactive tour of Boston's Freedom Trail. Designed for families with children 6-12 years old, this tour encourages discovery and exploration.

On this walk, children will experience historical sites that played a key role in the American Revolution. You will see Faneuil Hall, the Old State House and the Old South Meeting House. Hear stories of the many interesting people who have made Boston their home throughout history. Experience opportunities to interact with history at each stop, including the site of the first public school in America and the oldest burying ground in Boston.

The whole family will enjoy this hour-long tour in the heart of historic Boston!

PLEASE NOTE: All children must be accompanied by a ticketed adult.

what_is_included_items.value: Guided 60 minute outdoor tour exploring Boston's urban landscape
.73 mile tour at a moderate pace, stopping at various sites along the tour
On select dates this tour is offered in Spanish
